environment.topology: Dedicated named Herdr session; one temporary Git project; per-host panes and temporary profiles; OpenCode used a fully isolated HOME/XDG profile with --standalone.

claude.profileIsolation: Temporary CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR containing only a copied authentication record and generated session state.

start.summary: Herdr started Claude Code interactively in the owned pane and reported it idle with the expected cwd.
evidence: agent_started returned argv, pane_id, cwd, agent=claude, and interactive_ready=true.

tool_task.summary: The isolated session accepted the prompt but the provider rejected execution because its copied login had expired.

resume.summary: The exact captured UUID restored the prior conversation and prompt; provider execution remained unavailable.
evidence: The resumed UI displayed the original artifact prompt and the same authentication failure.

background_work.summary: Provider authentication prevented starting a real background tool or child process.

cancel_replace.summary: No real Claude workload could be started, so cancellation and replacement were not exercised.

teardown.summary: Native /exit returned to the pane shell, but no owned workload existed to prove descendant cleanup.
evidence: Herdr process-info showed fish as the foreground process after /exit.

nativeError.message: Session exit observed without a live child workload

codex.profileIsolation: Temporary CODEX_HOME containing only a copied auth.json and generated session state; --no-daemon prevents profile-scoped helpers surviving client exit.

start.summary: Herdr started Codex interactively in the owned pane and reported it idle with the expected cwd.
evidence: agent_started returned argv, pane_id, cwd, agent=codex, and interactive_ready=true.

tool_task.summary: Codex created and byte-verified a marker artifact with a real shell tool.
evidence: codex-artifact.txt contained exactly CODEX_PROBE_376 followed by newline.

resume.summary: The exact rollout UUID restored conversation memory and completed a second verified artifact.
evidence: session_meta.payload.id matched the resume UUID; codex-resumed.txt reproduced CODEX_PROBE_376.

background_work.summary: A real shell and sleep child continued after the foreground conversation was interrupted and were visible as live processes.
evidence: Both sh and sleep remained live while Herdr reported the agent done; the Codex UI showed one background terminal.

cancel_replace.summary: The bounded production sequence interrupted the turn, stopped the background terminal with /stop, then exited the exact session.
evidence: Owned sh pid 52762 and sleep pid 52808 disappeared; no-daemon-cancelled2.txt stayed absent; shutdownAgent returned exited in 2.43 seconds.

teardown.summary: With --no-daemon, /exit removed the exact Herdr agent and all owned workload processes after /stop.
evidence: Herdr returned agent_not_found, the delayed artifact stayed absent, and no matching sh or sleep survived.

cursor.profileIsolation: Owned Herdr pane; the native CLI stopped before profile creation because the login keychain was locked.

start.summary: Cursor Agent exited before interactive readiness because the macOS login keychain was locked.
evidence: Herdr agent start timed out and the owned pane returned to its shell.

nativeError.message: Your macOS login keychain is locked. Run security unlock-keychain and try again.

tool_task.summary: Cursor never reached an interactive session.

resume.summary: No Cursor session ID was created to resume.

background_work.summary: No Cursor session existed to start background work.

cancel_replace.summary: No Cursor workload existed to cancel or replace.

teardown.summary: Only the failed startup process exited; an active Cursor session teardown was not exercised.
evidence: The failed process returned the owned pane to fish.

opencode.profileIsolation: Temporary HOME and XDG data/config/cache/state roots with --standalone; no user session database or service was reused.

start.summary: OpenCode started against a fully isolated standalone profile and Herdr reported it idle in the owned pane.
evidence: agent_started returned the exact standalone argv, pane, cwd, and interactive_ready=true.

tool_task.summary: OpenCode used an explicit available model to create and read-verify a real artifact in the isolated profile.
evidence: JSON events carried one sessionID and completed patch/read tool states; opencode-strict-artifact.txt contained OPENCODE_STRICT_376.

resume.summary: The exact session ID restored prior context and completed a second verified artifact.
evidence: Isolated session list returned only the captured ID; the resumed UI recalled OPENCODE_STRICT_376 and verified opencode-strict-resumed.txt.

background_work.summary: A real sh and sleep child ran beneath the standalone OpenCode session and remained observable while the agent was working.
evidence: The owned sh and sleep PIDs were observed before cancellation.

cancel_replace.summary: Esc did not cancel; Ctrl-C terminated the standalone TUI and its sh/sleep descendants, and exact-ID restart completed new work.
evidence: No sh, sleep, or delayed artifact survived Ctrl-C; the restarted exact session created opencode-after-cancel.txt.

teardown.summary: Native /exit after recovery returned to fish with no matching standalone session or child process.
evidence: Herdr process-info showed only fish and process inspection found no session or sleep survivor.
